acknowledged.reason: The geometry fits stop at loose tolerances (5e-7) or after at most 140 evaluations, so the stopping point depends on rounding in the installed NumPy and SciPy. Terms fitted near zero move by up to 6e-4 of their value; losses and orbital parameters agree to better than one part in ten thousand. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in physical/README.md.

Same solver sensitivity, carried forward because each dilution fit starts from the previous one. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in physical/README.md.
Eight of 156 numbers move, by up to 9e-4 of their value, in terms fitted at the edge-on bound or near zero. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in physical/README.md.

The resamples are seeded; the refits have the same solver sensitivity. Single draws move by up to 0.6% and the quoted quantiles by at most 0.003 h, below their printed precision. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in physical/README.md.
